provenance_notes: Ten qualification measurements were imported by immutable manifest reference as repetition one; 44 measurements were executed in the formal campaign directory.
GPU energy is estimated by integrating sampled aggregate GPU board power and excludes non-GPU system power.
PCIe RX/TX and replay data were collected per GPU through DCGM exact-window exports; these are endpoint metrics, not direct internal PCIe-switch port counters.

Firezone was enabled after all measured runs completed but before the post-idle baseline; measured benchmark windows were unaffected, while pre/post network-idle comparison must disclose this difference.
